post.summary: Register a new file for upload
post.description:
## Register a new file for upload
Before a file can be uploaded it has to be registered for upload, files larger than 2MB should be uploaded in chunks of 1MB.
### Upload file < 2MB
1. Register file
   
   Request  
   
        POST /api/v1/file 
 
        {
          "parentCode": "41971e7ea8a446069a817e66b608dcae",
          "name": "MyFile.tiff",
          "size": 67351
        }
   
   Response  
   
        {
          "code":"a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb",
          "chunks":1
          "parentCode": "41971e7ea8a446069a817e66b608dcae",
          "name": "MyFile.tiff",
          "size": 67351,
          "chunkSize": 67351
        }
   
2. Upload chunk 
   
        POST /api/v1/file/a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb/1
        
        [Data]
### Upload file > 2MB
1. Register file 
   
   Request 
   
       POST /api/v1/file
       {
         "parentCode": "41971e7ea8a446069a817e66b608dcae",
         "name": "MyFile.tiff",
         "size": 100967351,
         "chunkSize": 1048576
       }
  
   Response  
  
       {
         "code":"a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb",
         "chunks":97
         "parentCode": "41971e7ea8a446069a817e66b608dcae",
         "name": "MyFile.tiff",
         "size": 100967351,
         "chunkSize": 1048576
       }
   
2. Upload chunks 
   
       POST /api/v1/file/a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb/1
        
       [Data]
   
       POST /api/v1/file/a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb/2
        
       [Data]
   
       POST /api/v1/file/a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb/n
        
       [Data]
   
       POST /api/v1/file/a00fbd18320742c787f99f952aef0dbb/97
        
       [Data]
